name: execute-hard-cutover
job: Hard-cut a predecessor to a destination sole writer and retire dual paths with backfill and proof.

inScope: Naming the cut surface and terminal: destination sole writer
Inventorying callers, data, docs, and feature flags that must migrate
Retiring predecessor paths in the same delivery unit
outOfScope: Permanent dual-write or dual-read steady state
Feature flags as the new system of record
Claiming done on a green dual-path

inputs: Predecessor and destination with their traffic/data surface
Real checks for the destination surface
outputs: Destination sole writer for the named surface
Predecessor retired or explicitly time-boxed with kill criteria
Evidence for backfill, cut, and residual list

tools: delivery tooling and real checks for the destination
data: state to backfill at the destination
permissions: mutation authority on the owning delivery path

failureSemantics: A green dual-path is not done; never-expiring feature flags and docs or installers still pointing at the predecessor are failures; cutover completes only when the destination handles the surface under real checks and the predecessor no longer receives production responsibility.

outcome.observable: The destination is the sole writer for the named surface under real checks, the predecessor is retired or time-boxed with kill criteria, and backfill, cut, and residual evidence are recorded.
